title: Principal strict total Koszul limit with its normalized unit is a reflector
statement: For the ringed site, module category, principal strict Koszul tower and normalized unit of [def-sf-regular-roos-koszul-data], with independent site universes, assume multiplication by t is monic. Then the total limit is locally derived (t)-complete and precomposition by its specified unit is a bijection into every locally derived (t)-complete object. The local test on every slice is vanishing of derived internal Hom from localization at any section which is a multiple of t. No K-flatness, boundedness or exact products are assumed. The monic multiplication map from the unit module presents the principal ideal.

source.place: Tags 099B (lemma-derived-completion), 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul); sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941. Principal regular-generator specialization with independent universes and the actual normalized strict unit.

proof.text: Restrict the coefficient sheaf and generator to the canonical small model. Monicity of multiplication transfers by sectionwise injectivity. The unit module has its one-element generating family, and multiplication sends its generator 1 to the restricted section, so it presents the principal ideal.
Apply the existing singleton ringed Koszul completion reflector to this unit-module ideal presentation on the small site, obtaining D, complete outputs and the Hom bijection.

The normalized strict small-model comparison gives an isomorphism E(koszulCompletion Q t) to D.completion(E(Q(Q))) carrying the actual koszulUnit to D.unit. The local-test comparison identifies the original local predicate with the small-site ideal predicate. Apply derived restriction and internal Hom to the output isomorphism and transfer output completeness back.

For a locally complete L, transfer its local tests to E(L). Compose the small reflector Hom bijection with the equivalence f maps to e.inv followed by E(f). The normalized unit equation and cancellation of e.hom with e.inv identify this composite with E applied to precomposition by koszulUnit. The fully faithful equivalence E gives a bijection on the target Hom set, so cancel it to obtain the required original Hom bijection.

theorem principal_strict_limit_reflector
    (t : (SheafOfModules.unit (ring.{c, v, r} R)).sections)
    (hreg : Mono (globalSectionMultiplication.{c, v, max c v r} R t))
    (Q : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, r} R) ℤ) :
    locallyComplete.{c, v, r, w} R t (koszulCompletion R Q t) ∧
      ∀ L, locallyComplete.{c, v, r, w} R t L →
        Function.Bijective (fun f : koszulCompletion R Q t ⟶ L ↦
        koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) Q (Iso.refl _) t ≫ f)
